name: homeledger
description: 自托管家庭记账系统（Cloudflare Workers + Hono + D1 + R2 + Cron）：全品类记账 + AI 截图/文本自动记账 + 开放 API

scripts.verify-notes: npx tsx .agents/skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts && npx tsx .agents/skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts && npx tsx .agents/skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts
scripts.init-board: npx tsx .agents/skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/build-board.ts --init board.html "HomeLedger 决策看板"
scripts.bundle-board: npx tsx .agents/skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/build-board.ts --bundle .agents/notes demo.html "HomeLedger 决策看板"
